caption: The drawing depicts a figurine of a woman standing upright. She is wearing a light brown dress with puffed sleeves, a yellow vest-like garment over the dress, and a white blouse underneath, visible at her neck and wrists. The skirt of the dress is wide and reaches just below her knees, exposing white, loose-fitting trousers or petticoats tucked into the tops of dark shoes. The woman’s hair is brown and parted in the middle, styled in two large curls that rest on her shoulders. She wears a wide-brimmed hat, colored light brown with a large red band and possibly a blue flower or decoration on the top. In her left hand, she is holding a small bunch of red and green flowers. The figurine stands on a rounded, pale base that blends seamlessly with the lower part of her clothing. The whole drawing is contained within a simple pencil border, and the background is plain, off-white or cream in color.
title: Pa. German Chalkware Bloomer Girl
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
